issues: At run start, two active pending masters were not identified by the older harness marker. A later strict-marker audit identified one as a newer test draft; the other remains unattributed and untouched.
Admin UI cleanup did not complete safely: The proven Admin cleanup row was not visible after exact-name search.

Post-run read-only check: two proven test-created pending masters are still active. The separate, unrelated pending master was not archived. Customer selection and the Admin acceptance flow were not verified.
